items.quote: And he hewed two tables of stone like unto the first
items.claim: Two stone tablets were cut to match the first ones.
items.object: two tables of stone like unto the first

items.quote: and Moses rose up early in the morning, and went up unto mount Sinai, as the LORD had commanded him
items.claim: Moses got up early and went up Mount Sinai, as the LORD had commanded him.
items.action: rose up early and went up
items.mechanism: as the LORD had commanded him

items.quote: and took in his hand the two tables of stone
items.claim: Moses carried the two stone tablets in his hand when he went up the mountain.
